title: Independent first-party blog deployment readback is the provider publication identity
root_cause: Original powerhouse_content_handoff_receipts_v1 used the global social external_id predicate for all channels. Production 2026-10-25 blog had LIVE_PROVEN timestamp, first-party HTTPS blog URL, exact HTTP 200 and Netlify deploy ID, but external_id was null and BRAIN classified it OVERDUE_PUBLICATION.
root_source: public.content_publication_obligations, original ONE BRAIN assurance owner #171
affected_scope: one proven 2026-10-25 original blog publication; social posts unchanged
control: On original blog use exact first-party URL, live_proven_at, LIVE_PROVEN/MEASURED/LEARNED state, independently recorded public HTTP 200 and nonempty Netlify deployment ID. On Instagram/LinkedIn keep external_id, provider_truth_verified, HTTPS canonical URL and live time. No publication or measurement inferred from status alone.
measured_audit: Current original blog MEASURED records may still lack GA4/GSC provider-linked event IDs; therefore only publish stage can advance. Exact metric, analysis and later proved experiment remain separate original obligations.
consumer: ONE BRAIN / Heartbeat original content closed-loop
